description: /fix-doc-todos with the go-ahead for the link markers given in the prompt: the settings-page markers are replaced by a root-relative link in the UA and EN pages and in the API pair's page, the content-gap marker and the NEEDS CONFIRMATION markers stay as they were, the report says what the alignment check (the last step of doc-todo-fixer) found, and nothing outside the three pages changes. The alignment check runs through the doc-alignment-checker skill (asserted). Covers the command and doc-todo-fixer together.
prompt:
/{plugin}:fix-doc-todos

Answers in advance, so don't stop to ask: I confirm the link markers (bucket A) as you would propose them, in every file where they occur. There is nothing for buckets B and C. Apply them now.

assertions.name: settings link marker gone from UA
assertions.pattern: ToDo: link to the settings page

assertions.name: settings link marker gone from EN
assertions.pattern: ToDo: link to the settings page

assertions.name: settings link marker gone from the API page
assertions.pattern: ToDo: link to the settings page

assertions.name: the API page links the settings page by route
UA sentence now carries the link
assertions.pattern: Про валюту за замовчуванням читайте в[^\n]*\]\(/portal/settings/settings\)

assertions.name: EN sentence now carries the link
NEEDS CONFIRMATION markers left
assertions.run: grep -q 'NEEDS CONFIRMATION: default currency' portal/settings/settings.md && grep -q 'NEEDS CONFIRMATION: default currency' i18n/en/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs-portal/current/settings/settings.md

assertions.name: report says what the alignment check found
